row:
At Veterinary Rehabilitation Services of Virginia we help animals recover from injury, illness or surgery and live comfortably through all stages of life with the use of skilled rehabilitation therapy. 

Through our educational and tutorial videos we aim to bring virtual rehabilitation education to you at home!
